description: MCP server for OpenRouter — chat with 300+ LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT), analyze images / audio / video, generate images / speech / music / video (Veo 3.1, Sora, Seedance, Wan) from Claude Desktop, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code.

input_dir.title: Input Directory
input_dir.description: Sandbox root for input_images on generate_image. Falls back to the Output Directory.

output_dir.title: Output Directory
output_dir.description: Sandbox root for save_path on generate_* tools. Leave empty to use the current working directory.

default_model.title: Default Model
default_model.description: Default model for chat + analyze tools.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API Key
openrouter_api_key.description: Your OpenRouter API key. Get one free at https://openrouter.ai/keys

tool_signatures.name: analyze_audio
tool_signatures.description: Transcribe or analyze an audio file (WAV / MP3 / FLAC / OGG / etc.) using a multimodal model. Output is tagged `_meta.content_is_untrusted: true`.

question.description: Question or instruction about the audio (default: transcribe)

audio_path.description: File path, URL, or data URL (base64-encoded audio)

parameters.name: audio_path
parameters.description: File path, URL, or data URL (base64-encoded audio)

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: Question or instruction about the audio (default: transcribe)

tool_signatures.name: analyze_image
tool_signatures.description: Analyze an image with a vision model. Accepts local file paths, http(s) URLs, or base64 data URLs. Output is model-generated and tagged `_meta.content_is_untrusted: true`.

image_path.description: File path, URL, or data URL

cache_input.description: Attach `cache_control: ephemeral` to the image block so Anthropic / Gemini prompt-cache it. Repeat questions about the same image save ~10x on Anthropic.

parameters.name: cache_input
parameters.description: Attach `cache_control: ephemeral` to the image block so Anthropic / Gemini prompt-cache it. Repeat questions about the same image save ~10x on Anthropic.

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: File path, URL, or data URL

tool_signatures.name: analyze_video
tool_signatures.description: Describe or analyze a video (mp4 / mpeg / mov / webm) using a multimodal model. Default model: google/gemini-2.5-flash. Output is tagged `_meta.content_is_untrusted: true`.

video_path.description: File path, HTTP(S) URL, or base64 data URL. Supported: mp4 / mpeg / mov / webm.

parameters.name: video_path
parameters.description: File path, HTTP(S) URL, or base64 data URL. Supported: mp4 / mpeg / mov / webm.

tool_signatures.name: chat_completion
tool_signatures.description: Send messages to an OpenRouter model and get a text response. Supports provider routing (quantizations / ignore / sort / order / require_parameters / data_collection / allow_fallbacks), model variant suffixes (`:nitro` fastest, `:floor` cheapest, `:exacto` tool-calling accuracy), reasoning token passthrough, web search, and response caching.

cache.description: Enable OpenRouter response caching via `X-OpenRouter-Cache: true`. Server-wide default settable via `OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES=1`.

model.description: Model ID (optional, uses default). Append `:nitro` for the fastest variant, `:floor` for the cheapest, or `:exacto` for the best tool-calling accuracy. Example: `openai/gpt-4o:nitro`.

provider.description: OpenRouter provider-routing overrides. Merges on top of `OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_*` env defaults. See https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/provider-routing

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens. Falls back to `OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS` env var if unset.

cache_clear.description: Bust the cache entry for this exact request.

include_reasoning.description: Surface the model's chain-of-thought on `_meta.reasoning` for R1 / Opus 4.7 / Gemini Thinking.

parameters.name: cache
parameters.description: Enable OpenRouter response caching via `X-OpenRouter-Cache: true`. Server-wide default settable via `OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES=1`.

parameters.name: cache_clear
parameters.description: Bust the cache entry for this exact request.

parameters.name: include_reasoning
parameters.description: Surface the model's chain-of-thought on `_meta.reasoning` for R1 / Opus 4.7 / Gemini Thinking.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Max completion tokens. Falls back to `OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS` env var if unset.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model ID (optional, uses default). Append `:nitro` for the fastest variant, `:floor` for the cheapest, or `:exacto` for the best tool-calling accuracy. Example: `openai/gpt-4o:nitro`.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: OpenRouter provider-routing overrides. Merges on top of `OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_*` env defaults. See https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/provider-routing

tool_signatures.name: generate_audio
tool_signatures.description: Generate audio (speech / music) from a text prompt. Format auto-detected, extension auto-corrected.

tool_signatures.name: generate_image
tool_signatures.description: Generate an image from a text prompt. Optional reference images condition the output for style / identity consistency. Default model: google/gemini-2.5-flash-image.

tool_signatures.name: generate_video
tool_signatures.description: Generate a video from a text prompt (optionally conditioned on first/last-frame or reference images). Submits an async job, polls until completion or max_wait_ms, and downloads the result. Emits MCP progress notifications when the client provides a `progressToken`. Default model: google/veo-3.1.

tool_signatures.name: generate_video_from_image
tool_signatures.description: Narrower convenience wrapper around generate_video for image-to-video workflows. Takes a single `image` argument (used as the first frame) and `prompt`. Per arxiv 2511.03497, narrower tools with fewer parameters improve tool-call hit rate. For last-frame conditioning or reference images, use generate_video directly.

image.description: First-frame image (path, URL, or data URL). Required.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: First-frame image (path, URL, or data URL). Required.

tool_signatures.name: get_model_info
tool_signatures.description: Get pricing / context-length / capability details for a specific model id.

tool_signatures.name: get_video_status
tool_signatures.description: Poll an async video-generation job by id. Downloads the result when complete (and saves if save_path given).

tool_signatures.name: health_check
tool_signatures.description: Verify API-key validity, OpenRouter reachability, and return server + protocol versions. No args.

tool_signatures.name: rerank_documents
tool_signatures.description: Re-order a list of documents by relevance to a query using an OpenRouter reranker. Default model: cohere/rerank-english-v3.0.

tool_signatures.name: search_models
tool_signatures.description: Search OpenRouter's model catalog by name, provider, or capability. Returns a paginated list; use `offset` / `limit` / `next_offset` to page through.

tool_signatures.name: validate_model
tool_signatures.description: Check whether a model id exists on OpenRouter. Cheap boolean lookup against the cached catalog.
